Seven far-distance spiking-model clips had correct totals despite event-timing mismatches, demonstrating why total-count and event-level measurements must be reported together. The results support the feasibility of causal optical-flow counting in the tested setting and identify boundary-sensitive errors. They do not establish an architecture ranking across repeated training, real-flight robustness, or hardware efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于MuJoCo仿真环境的方法，利用搭载在微型飞行器上的虚拟相机通过符号光流来计数扑翼飞行器的扇翅次数。
AI.motivation: 扑翼飞行器的视觉监测需要从运动强度和平均频率中区分出单独的扇翅动作，为此需要评估在控制场景下基于光流进行扇翅计数的可能性和不同架构的性能。
AI.method: 结合空间卷积编码器与因果时间卷积网络、循环漏电积分发放脉冲网络或因果自注意力机制，预测相位和活动状态，并使用有向交叉事件计数器进行计数。
AI.result: 在1.5米距离下，三种模型的精确计数准确率分别为96.67%、95.00%和96.67%；在3.0米距离下分别为94.44%、92.22%和95.00%，且模型间差异不显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了在测试设置下使用因果光流进行计数的的可行性，指出了边界敏感的错误，并强调了同时报告总计数和事件级测量的重要性。

title: PanoGS-SLAM: Panoramic 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary: Real-time dense SLAM is a core capability for robotics applications that require robust localization and high- quality mapping in dynamic or fast-changing environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based SLAM methods have shown promising performance, but most are designed for narrow-FoV pinhole cameras, where limited angular coverage weakens pose observability and often leads to unstable photo- metric optimization under rapid motion and large viewpoint changes. We present PanoGS-SLAM, the first panoramic dense SLAM system built on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method per- forms differentiable rendering and pose optimization directly in the spherical domain, enabling omnidirectional photometric constraints for more stable tracking. To improve geometric consistency and robustness, we introduce (1) a sphere-consistent photometric loss that compensates for the area distortion of equirectangular projection, and (2) a depth-guided Gaussian initialization strategy that stabilizes incremental mapping in newly observed regions. Extensive experiments on both real and synthetic panoramic benchmarks (PALVIO and SynPano) show that PanoGS-SLAM consistently outperforms geometric and GS-based baselines in tracking accuracy and rendering quality, while achieving fast front-end convergence and real-time perfor- mance. In addition, controlled field-of-view experiments reveal a clear monotonic improvement in optimization conditioning and convergence stability as angular coverage increases, high- lighting the fundamental role of sensing geometry in shaping the optimization landscape of differentiable Gaussian-based SLAM. The source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: PanoGS-SLAM是一个基于3D高斯散射的首个全景稠密SLAM系统，利用球面域的可微分渲染和位姿优化实现全方位光度约束，提高了动态和快速变化环境下的追踪稳定性和建图质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于3D高斯散射的SLAM方法多针对窄视场针孔相机，在快速运动和大视角变化下存在姿态可观测性弱、光度优化不稳定等问题。
AI.method: 直接在球面域进行可微分渲染和位姿优化，引入补偿等距投影面积畸变的球面一致光度损失，以及用于稳定增量建图的深度引导高斯初始化策略。
AI.result: 在真实和合成全景基准测试（PALVIO和SynPano）上的实验表明，PanoGS-SLAM在追踪精度和渲染质量上均优于现有的几何和基于GS的基线，同时实现了快速的前端收敛和实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 全景相机的广角覆盖能够显著改善可微分高斯SLAM中优化条件和收敛稳定性，证明了传感几何形状在优化过程中的根本作用。

title: Semantic-Spatial Agreement Verification for Mitigating Object Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models generate natural-language responses from visual inputs, yet may mention objects absent from an image. In medication assistance, accessible perception, and environmental decision-making, such hallucinations can create real-world safety risks. We propose Semantic-Spatial Agreement Verification (SSAV), a training-free method for verifying object claims. A visually grounded claim should remain stable across semantically equivalent queries and repeatedly localize to the same image region. SSAV aggregates multiple prompts to estimate semantic support and reduce sensitivity to query wording. Query-Induced Regional Verification (QIRV) combines cross-query region persistence, spatial overlap, and relative candidate dominance to identify isolated high responses and dispersed localizations. A geometric mean fuses semantic and spatial evidence, lowering the verification score when either branch lacks support. Experiments on three base models and multiple evaluation protocols show that SSAV effectively mitigates object hallucination. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, accuracy averaged across COCO, A-OKVQA, and GQA improves by 1.81 and 3.17 percentage points under POPE Popular and Adversarial, respectively, while CHAIRs decreases from 49.40% to 32.80%. These results show that cross-query semantic stability and regional consistency provide interpretable external visual evidence for object claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为语义-空间一致性验证（SSAV）的免训练方法，旨在减少多模态大语言模型中的物体幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉输入生成文本时可能会提及图像中不存在的物体，这在医疗辅助和环境决策等领域会引发真实的现实安全风险。
AI.method: 提出语义-空间一致性验证（SSAV），通过聚合多个提示词来评估语义支持以减少对查询措辞的敏感性，并结合查询诱导区域验证（QIRV）来检查跨查询的区域持久性、空间重叠和相对候选优势，最后用几何平均值融合语义和空间证据。
AI.result: 在三个基础模型和多个评估协议上的实验表明，SSAV能有效缓解物体幻觉。在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，COCO、A-OKVQA和GQA的平均准确率在POPE Popular和Adversarial下分别提高了1.81和3.17个百分点，同时CHAIRs从49.40%降至32.80%。
AI.conclusion: 跨查询的语义稳定性和区域一致性为物体声明提供了可解释的外部视觉证据，能有效缓解多模态大语言模型的物体幻觉。

title: PhysStream: Streaming Physics-Grounded Video Generation with Structured Scene Memory and Fine-Grained Motion Control
summary: Interactive control for video generation is moving from coarse prompts toward fine-grained, physically meaningful manipulation of dynamic scenes. Yet existing controllable methods either require the full control schedule before generation starts, or use pixel-space signals that dictate object positions rather than physical dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose PhysStream, an autoregressive model for physics-grounded image-to-video synthesis that incorporates structured scene memory---positional maps and object tracking maps derived online from previously generated frames---and supports fine-grained motion control via sparse velocity-increment signals that encode physical quantities, letting the model learn the underlying dynamics. We train our model in two stages: a bidirectional model is first finetuned with motion-control conditioning, then a causal autoregressive model is trained with additional structured scene memory, further improving physical consistency. PhysStream enables interactive, mid-generation control over multi-object tabletop rigid-body scenes---a capability not supported by prior methods---reducing motion distribution distance (FVMD) by 33% and trajectory error by 12% over the strongest baselines on synthetic benchmarks, and is preferred by human evaluators in over 85% of in-the-wild comparisons. Please check our website for more details: https://czzzzh.github.io/PhysStream

AI.tldr: PhysStream是一个支持物理接地和交互式控制的图生视频自回归模型，能够通过稀疏速度增量信号实现细粒度的运动控制。
AI.motivation: 现有可控视频生成方法通常需要预先提供完整的控制计划，或使用仅限制物体位置而非物理动态的像素空间信号，无法进行生成过程中的交互式物理动态控制。
AI.method: 提出基于自回归的PhysStream模型，包含从先前帧在线衍生的结构化场景内存（位置图和物体跟踪图），并支持通过编码物理量的稀疏速度增量信号进行微观运动控制。分两阶段训练：先微调双向模型以适应运动控制条件，再训练因果自回归模型并结合结构化场景内存以增强物理一致性。
AI.result: 在多物体桌面刚体场景中实现了交互式生成中控制，相比最强基线，运动分布距离（FVMD）降低了33%，轨迹误差降低了12%，在真实场景对比中受到85%以上人类评估者的青睐。
AI.conclusion: PhysStream通过引入结构化场景内存和基于物理的速度增量控制信号，有效解决了现有视频生成方法缺乏交互式、物理真实动态控制的问题，显著提升了视频生成的物理一致性和交互性能。

title: SSC-Priors: Exploring Semantic and Visibility Priors to Boost Lidar Semantic Scene Completion
summary: This paper investigates easy strategies to boost the performance of existing networks for lidar semantic scene completion (SSC) without requiring complex architectural redesigns. The fact is that, over the last years, SSC methods have mostly pursued architectural innovations, making the models heavier and more complex, e.g., by jointly training a point cloud semantic segmentation branch. In this work, we take a step back and explore two priors used as simple ingredients (possibly noisy) to improve existing approaches: semantic pseudo-labels and sensor visibility information. Concretely, we provide both kinds of information directly as additional inputs to a given SSC network, requiring only a minimal adaptation of the original architecture. We first demonstrate that endowing input point clouds with semantic pseudo-labels from off-the-shelf segmenters significantly improves the performance of existing SSC models. In fact, by evaluating these models against an oracle, we establish that high-quality semantic priors are a primary driver of semantic gains (mIoU), and that the SSC model can be trained just once with ground-truth semantics and then exploited without retraining using any segmenter. Furthermore, we equip the input lidar point cloud with visibility information that distinguishes between empty spaces (between the lidar and a scanned point) and unknown spaces (outside of lines of sight), providing a secondary performance boost across the tested architectures. We study the design space of data for representing visibility information and bound the remaining headroom with a ground-truth oracle on the free-space labels. On SemanticKITTI, these enhancements make older models competitive with state-of-the-art systems across four architectures, in one case even outperforming them. On the SSCBench-nuScenes benchmark, both priors also transfer with the sparser 32-beam sensor.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过引入语义伪标签和传感器可见性信息两种简单的数据先验，无需复杂架构重新设计，即可显著提升现有激光雷达语义场景补全(SSC)网络性能的策略。
AI.motivation: 近年来SSC方法过度追求复杂的架构创新（如联合训练点云语义分割分支），导致模型笨重。本文旨在退一步，探索通过简单的输入级先验来提升现有模型的性能。
AI.method: 将来自现成分割器的语义伪标签和区分空闲空间与未知空间的传感器可见性信息作为附加输入提供给现有的SSC网络，仅对原始架构进行极小的调整。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI和SSCBench-nuScenes基准测试中，这两种增强使旧模型在四种架构上均能与甚至超越最先进的系统相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 高质的语义先验和可见性信息是提升SSC性能的关键驱动力，通过简单的数据输入修改即可让旧模型焕发新生，而无需复杂的架构重构。

title: BrainFocus: EEG-Guided ROI Selection for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong visual question answering (VQA) performance, but processing large cluttered images is computationally expensive when only a small region is relevant. Electroencephalography (EEG) signals, which capture human neural responses to visual stimuli, can provide a human-derived semantic cue about the region of interest (ROI). However, EEG-guided visual category decoding remains imperfect, making direct ROI routing unreliable. In this work, we propose BrainFocus, a reliable EEG-guided efficient VLM framework for VQA. An EEG classifier predicts a target category, and a YOLO detector localizes the matching ROI. The VLM receives the cropped ROI only when both predictions pass confidence thresholds; otherwise, it processes the full image. For evaluation, we build on EEG-ImageNet to construct a 40-class benchmark comprising generated cluttered images and real object-centric images, with target-ROI annotations and 600 English visual question-answer pairs. Across Qwen3.5-VL 2B, 4B, and 9B models, BrainFocus improves VQA accuracy by 4.14-9.87 percentage points (pp) on cluttered scenes while reducing input tokens and total tokens by 23.2%-39.4% and 23.2%-39.3%, and end-to-end floating-point operations (FLOPs) by 23.2%-39.5%. These results demonstrate that EEG can guide efficient VLM inference even when its semantic decoding is imperfect.

AI.tldr: BrainFocus是一个利用脑电图（EEG）信号引导视觉语言模型（VLM）进行高效视觉问答（VQA）的框架，通过结合EEG分类器与YOLO检测器定位感兴趣区域，从而在减少计算开销的同时提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 处理复杂的视觉图像对VLM而言计算成本高昂，而人类的EEG信号能够提供有关感兴趣区域（ROI）的语义线索，但直接依赖不完美的EEG解码进行区域路由是不可靠的，因此需要一个既能利用脑电信号又具有容错机制的高效VLM框架。
AI.method: 提出BrainFocus框架：首先通过EEG分类器预测目标类别，然后利用YOLO检测器定位匹配的ROI；只有当两个预测都通过置信度阈值时，VLM才仅处理裁剪后的ROI，否则处理全图。
AI.result: 在包含40个类别的自定义基准测试中，BrainFocus在多个Qwen-VL模型上将复杂场景下的VQA准确率提升了4.14-9.87个百分点，同时减少了23.2%-39.4%的输入/总Token以及23.2%-39.5%的FLOPs。
AI.conclusion: 即使EEG的语义解码存在不完美，它依然可以有效地引导VLM进行高效推理，在降低计算成本的同时显著提升VQA性能。

title: ORCA: Occlusion-Aware Refinement and Completion for Novel View Synthesis
summary:
Novel-view synthesis from a single image is a fundamentally ambiguous problem. As the camera moves away from the input viewpoint, previously hidden regions become visible, exposing missing geometry and holes in the reconstructed scene. Existing methods often rely on generative models to complete such regions. However, many of these artifacts are small gaps near depth boundaries and do not require generating new scene content.
  In order to eliminate expensive process of generating image we introduce ORCA, an occlusion-aware method for reconstructing and completing explorable 3D scenes from a single image. ORCA first introduces 3D structure into a Gaussian-anchor representation using monocular depth while preserving the original camera-ray correspondence. During scene exploration, missing regions are handled based on their size and structure. Small disocclusions are repaired using RGB-D information already available in the reconstruction, while generative inpainting is reserved for larger regions that cannot be reliably recovered from the scene. New Gaussian anchors are added and optimized locally without modifying the existing representation. By reducing unnecessary reliance on generative inpainting, ORCA limits generation-induced hallucinations and better preserves the content and structure of the original scene.
  On DIV2K, ORCA improves novel-view quality over VistaDream across all reported metrics, increasing MUSIQ from 61.60 to 68.71 and CLIP-IQA from 0.474 to 0.574. These results show that many novel-view artifacts can be repaired effectively by reusing information already present in the reconstructed scene.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了ORCA，一种基于单张图像的遮挡感知3D场景重建与补全方法，通过优先复用已有场景信息减少对生成式修复的依赖。
AI.motivation: 单图新视角合成中的遮挡区域通常包含许多深度边界附近的小间隙，不需要生成新的场景内容，而现有的生成模型往往会导致昂贵的开销和不必要的幻觉。
AI.method: 利用单目深度将3D结构引入高斯锚点表示，并保留原始相机射线对应关系；根据缺失区域的大小和结构进行处理，小遮挡通过现有的RGB-D信息修复，大区域才使用生成式修复，同时局部优化和添加新的高斯锚点而不修改现有表示。
AI.result: 在DIV2K数据集上，ORCA在所有报告的指标上均优于VistaDream，将MUSIQ从61.60提高到68.71，CLIP-IQA从0.474提高到0.574。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用重建场景中已有的信息，可以有效修复许多新视角伪影，从而限制生成引起的幻觉并更好地保持原场景的内容和结构。

title: Tables Decoded: DELTA for Structure, TARQA for Understanding
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2026
summary: Table understanding is a core task in document intelligence, encompassing two key subtasks: table reconstruction and table visual question answering (TabVQA). While recent approaches predominantly rely on vision- language models (VLMs) operating on table images, we propose a more scalable and effective alternative based on structured textual representations. These representations are easier to process, align more naturally with LLMs, and eliminate the need for language-specific visual encoders, making them particularly suitable for multilingual documents. We present DELTA, which separates physical structure recognition, logical structure recognition, and OCR to extract both layout and content accurately. DELTA outputs tables in Optimised Table Structure Language (OTSL), a compact and unified format that encodes cell arrangements and textual content. On table structure recognition (TSR), DELTA achieves TEDS- Structure scores comparable with state-of-the-art methods across FinTabNet, PubTabNet, and PubTables-1M. We further establish its robustness on non-English tables through our curated Hindi benchmark, TORQUE. Building on this, we introduce TARQA, an LLM fine-tuned on OTSL sequences. Our approach yields gains of 9.3 p.p. on WTQ (TabQA) and 9.2 p.p. on FinTabNetQA (TabVQA), respectively. On TORQUE, our method ranks second among all VLMs and DELTA + LLM variants. We release our code, models, and benchmark at: https://github.com/Tihiitborg/Tables-Decoded

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DELTA和TARQA，利用结构化文本表示代替视觉语言模型进行表格理解，在表格重建和表格视觉问答任务上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖基于表格图像的视觉语言模型（VLMs），而结构化文本表示更容易处理、更贴合大语言模型（LLMs），且无需特定语言的视觉编码器，因此更适合多语言文档。
AI.method: 提出了DELTA方法，分离物理结构识别、逻辑结构识别和OCR，以优化的表格结构语言（OTSL）输出表格；并引入了在OTSL序列上微调的大语言模型TARQA用于表格问答。
AI.result: DELTA在多个数据集上的表格结构识别（TSR）达到了与SOTA相当的TEDS-Structure分数，并在WTQ和FinTabNetQA上分别取得了9.3个百分点和9.2个百分点的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于结构化文本表示和LLM的方法在表格理解任务中具有极高的可扩展性、有效性以及跨语言鲁棒性。
